1. Plnka: v mise stojanového mixéra s plochým miešadlom spojíme maslo, kandizovaný alebo karamelizovaný cukor, škoricu, muškátový oriešok a soľ. Miešame na nízkej rýchlosti, kým sa nezvlhčia, potom zvýšime na strednú a tmavú pastu šľaháme, kým nie je krémová, svetlá a veľmi mäkká, asi 5 minút. Preložíme do uzatvárateľného vrecka alebo jednorazového cukrárskeho vrecka a odložíme, kým ju nebudeme potrebovať, najviac 24 hodín pri izbovej teplote.

2. Cesto: misu vytrieme papierovou utierkou, potom metličkou dôkladne premiešame múku, cukor, droždie, soľ a sódu bikarbónu. V 1890 ml kastróliku rozpustíme na miernom ohni maslo, vmiešame mlieko a jogurt a zohrejeme asi na 27 °C. Pridáme k múke a premiešame na veľmi suché a strapaté cesto. S hákom na cesto miesime na nízkej rýchlosti, kým nie je hodvábne hladké a pružné, aby sa dalo jemne natiahnuť na tenkú, hoci nerovnú blanu bez roztrhnutia, asi 20 minút.

3. Prvé kysnutie: misu prikryjeme fóliou a cesto necháme kysnúť, kým nie je nadýchané, ľahké a nezdvojnásobí objem, asi 90 minút pri teplote približne 21 °C. Ak je cesto husté, pevné alebo príliš pružné, necháme ho 15 minút odpočívať a potom ho znova vyskúšame (to sa stáva skôr v chladných mesiacoch).

4. Karamelová poleva: tesne pred tvarovaním cesta vystelieme hliníkovú zapekaciu formu s rozmermi 23 × 33 × 5 cm papierom na pečenie (alebo použijeme dve papierom vystlané okrúhle formy na tortu s rozmermi 20 × 7,5 cm). Do formy dáme kandizovaný alebo karamelizovaný cukor spolu so soľou a obyčajnou alebo karamelizovanou smotanou (alebo ich rovnomerne rozdelíme do dvoch foriem). Vidličkou zhruba premiešame.

5. Tvarovanie: cesto vyklopíme na zľahka pomúčenú plochu, poprášime múkou a vyvaľkáme na štvorec so stranou 33 cm. Z vrecka so škoricovou plnkou odstrihneme roh, plnku vytlačíme na cesto a lomenou stierkou rozotrieme do rovnomernej vrstvy. Navrch posypeme pekanové orechy a zvinieme do valca dlhého 30 cm, ktorý skončí spojom nadol.

6. Pod cesto podsunieme 20 cm dlhú niť, neochutenú zubnú niť alebo mäsiarsky špagát až do stredu. Konce prekrížime navrchu a pevne potiahneme, aby sme valec rozdelili na dve časti. Každú polovicu nakrájame na šesť plátkov hrubých 2,5 cm a uložíme ich do pripravenej formy (foriem).

7. Druhé kysnutie: slimáky prikryjeme alobalom a necháme cez noc, alebo najviac 48 hodín, v chladničke. Rošt nastavíme do stredu rúry a rúru rozohrejeme na 180 °C (teplovzdušnú na 160 °C); medzitým necháme formu (formy) postáť pri izbovej teplote, kým sa rúra nezohreje.

8. Pečenie a podávanie: pečieme prikryté, kým nie sú slimáky nadýchané a pevné, ale bledé, asi 40 minút. (Ak používame tmavé formy, škoricové slimáky skontrolujeme po 25 minútach.) Odstránime alobal a pečieme ďalej, kým nie sú zľahka opečené, ešte asi 10 minút. Slimáky tupým nožom uvoľníme od okraja formy a vyklopíme na servírovací tanier (alebo taniere). Hneď podávame.

en.v: The coco breads are best eaten fresh, but can be kept in an airtight container for up to 5 hours before serving; rewarm before serving.

sk.v: Coco bread je najlepší čerstvý, v uzatvárateľnej nádobe ho však môžeme uchovávať až 5 hodín pred podávaním; pred podávaním ho ohrejeme.

en.t: 625 g low protein all-purpose flour, such as Gold Medal Blue Label, plus more for dusting
85 g sugar
14 g (4 tsp) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume or use the same weight
12 g (1 rounded tbsp) instant dry yeast, such as SAF; not RapidRise or active dry
56 g (4 tbsp) melted unsalted butter, plus more for brushing and greasing
355 g whole milk, warmed to about 38 °C

sk.t: 625 g hladká múka s nízkym obsahom bielkovín, napr. Gold Medal Blue Label, a trochu navyše na podsypanie
14 g (4 ČL) hrubozrnná soľ Diamond Crystal (pri jemnej soli dáme objemovo polovicu, hmotnostne rovnako)
12 g (1 vrchovatá PL) instantné sušené droždie, napr. SAF (nie RapidRise ani aktívne sušené droždie)
56 g (4 tbsp) melted unsalted butter, plus more for brushing and greasing
355 g whole milk, warmed to about 38 °C

en.t: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, salt, and yeast.

2. Add melted butter to dry ingredients and stir with a wooden spoon until well combined. Add warmed milk and stir until dry ingredients are fully incorporated and a slightly sticky dough begins to form.
3. Scrape dough out onto a lightly floured work surface and knead, dusting lightly with additional flour as needed to prevent sticking, until a soft, elastic dough forms, 5 to 10 minutes.

4. Wash, dry, and then grease the mixing bowl. Return dough to bowl, cover with plastic, and let proof at warm room temperature until puffy, light, and roughly doubled in size, 1 to 2 hours. In a chilly kitchen, the dough will need more time to rise, and in a warmer kitchen, it will move faster.

5. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). Line 2 rimmed baking sheets with parchment paper. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured work surface. To make small coco breads, divide dough into 45 g portions; to make larger ones, divide into 115 g portions. This recipe yields either 25 small or 10 large portions.

6. Working with one portion of dough at a time, gently roll each portion into a ball, then, using a rolling pin and dusting very lightly with flour as needed to prevent sticking, roll out into 3 mm-thick rounds. Brush top side of round with melted butter, then fold in half to form a half-moon shape. Brush top surface of half-moon with additional melted butter, then fold once more to form a quarter-circle. Transfer to prepared baking sheet. Repeat with remaining dough portions; leave about 4 cm of space between each portion of dough on the baking sheet.

7. Working with one baking sheet at a time, bake coco breads until puffed and lightly golden on top, about 15 minutes for smaller coco breads and 20 minutes for larger ones. Repeat with remaining baking sheet of coco breads. Brush baked coco breads with additional melted butter, if desired. Serve.

1. Vo veľkej mise metličkou premiešame múku, cukor, soľ a droždie.

2. K suchým surovinám pridáme rozpustené maslo a varechou miešame, kým sa dobre nespoja. Pridáme zohriate mlieko a miešame, kým sa suché suroviny úplne nezapracujú a nezačne sa tvoriť mierne lepkavé cesto.
3. Cesto zoškrabeme na zľahka pomúčenú pracovnú plochu a miesime, podľa potreby zľahka podsypávame ďalšou múkou, aby sa nelepilo, kým nevznikne mäkké, pružné cesto, 5 až 10 minút.

4. Misu umyjeme, osušíme a vymastíme. Cesto vrátime do misy, prikryjeme fóliou a necháme kysnúť pri teplej izbovej teplote, kým nie je nadýchané, ľahké a zhruba nezdvojnásobí objem, 1 až 2 hodiny. V chladnej kuchyni bude cesto potrebovať na kysnutie viac času, v teplejšej kuchyni pôjde rýchlejšie.

5. Rošt nastavíme do stredu rúry a rúru rozohrejeme na 175 °C (teplovzdušnú na 155 °C). 2 plechy s okrajom vystelieme papierom na pečenie. Cesto vyklopíme na zľahka pomúčenú pracovnú plochu. Na malé coco bread rozdelíme cesto na diely po 45 g; na väčšie na diely po 115 g. Z tohto receptu bude buď 25 malých, alebo 10 veľkých kusov.

6. S každým dielom cesta pracujeme zvlášť: jemne ho vytvarujeme do guľky a potom ho valčekom, podľa potreby len veľmi zľahka poprášeným múkou, aby sa nelepilo, vyvaľkáme na placky hrubé 3 mm. Vrchnú stranu placky potrieme rozpusteným maslom a preložíme na polovicu do tvaru polmesiaca. Vrch polmesiaca potrieme ďalším rozpusteným maslom a ešte raz preložíme na štvrťkruh. Preložíme na pripravený plech. Opakujeme so zvyšnými dielmi cesta; medzi jednotlivými kusmi na plechu necháme asi 4 cm miesta.

7. Pečieme vždy jeden plech, kým coco bread nie sú nadýchané a navrchu zľahka zlatisté, asi 15 minút pri menších a 20 minút pri väčších. Opakujeme so zvyšným plechom. Upečené coco bread podľa chuti potrieme ďalším rozpusteným maslom. Podávame.

en.t: 170 g sour cream

sk.t: 2 veľké vajcia (≈100 g bez škrupiny) (1 žĺtok odložiť na potretie)

en.t: 1. To make the dough: Warm the sour cream to lukewarm in a microwave, or over very low heat while stirring constantly. Add the butter and stir until melted.
2. Weigh your flour. In another bowl, whisk together the flour, yeast and salt.
3. Add the dry ingredients to the sour cream mixture, then stir in 1 large egg and 1 egg white.
4. Stir until the mixture comes together to form a shaggy mass, then set it aside for 15 minutes.
5. Knead the dough — by hand, electric mixer, food processor or bread machine — until it's smooth and elastic, adding a small amount of water or flour, if needed.
6. Place it in a greased bowl, cover the bowl, and set the dough aside to rise for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, until it's nearly doubled in bulk.
7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly greased surface and knead it gently a few times, to expel the excess carbon dioxide.
8. Divide it into three equal pieces, and roll each piece into a 46 cm log.
9. Braid the logs together, pinching them at both ends and tucking the pinched ends under.
10. Place the braid on a lightly greased or parchment-lined baking sheet, cover it, and allow it to rise for 45 to 50 minutes.
11. Toward the end of the rise, preheat the oven to 190 °C (fan 170 °C).
12. To make the glaze: Whisk the egg yolk with the water, and brush the braid with this glaze.
13. To bake the braid: Bake the bread for 30 to 35 minutes, or until it's golden brown and shiny.
14. Remove bread from the oven and let it cool on the pan for 10 minutes, then transfer it to a wire rack to cool completely.
15. Store the bread, well-wrapped, at room temperature for up to 5 days or in the freezer for up to 3 months.

en.t: 1. Preheat the oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). Butter a small (20 × 10 cm or smaller) bread pan and dust lightly with flour. Line with parchment if desired. Alternatively, use buttered and floured mini-muffin molds or silicone mini muffin molds.
2. Place the honey and sugar in a small saucepan, insert a thermometer and heat to 70 °C while stirring with a rubber spatula.
3. Sift together the whole wheat flour, rye flour, baking powder, spices and salt and transfer them to the bowl of your mixer.

4. In a small bowl whisk together the milk and whole eggs. Turn the mixer on low and slowly add the milk and egg mixture. Stop the mixer and, using a rubber spatula or a plastic bowl scraper, scrape up any flour sticking to the bottom of the bowl. Add the warm honey mixture and mix on medium speed until incorporated. Scrape into the bread pan or spoon about 1 to 2 tsp (5–10 ml) into each mini-mold, filling them 3/4 full.

5. Bake mini-cakes for 15 to 20 minutes, loaves for 40 to 45 minutes, until deep brown and a tester comes out clean. Remove from the heat, unmold and cool on a rack. If making a loaf, for best results, once cool wrap tightly in plastic and allow the cake to rest for a day.

en.t: 250 ml warm water
1 tsp (3 g) active dry yeast
140 g sesame seeds
A pinch of granulated sugar
205 g durum semolina flour
120 g unbleached all-purpose flour
1 tsp (3 g) kosher salt
2 tbsp (30 ml) extra-virgin olive oil
Additional extra-virgin olive oil and kosher salt for baking the breadsticks

sk.t: 205 g semolinová múka z tvrdej pšenice
ďalší extra panenský olivový olej a hrubozrnná soľ na pečenie tyčiniek

en.t: 1. Place 59 ml of the warm water in a small bowl and sprinkle over the yeast. Add a pinch of sugar and stir the yeast to dissolve it. Set the bowl aside to proof for 5 to 7 minutes.

2. Place the semolina and all-purpose flour in the bowl of an electric mixer along with the salt and 2 tbsp (18 g) of the sesame seeds, and stir to combine them. Check the yeast to make sure it has proofed; it will appear foamy, with bubbles forming on the surface.

3. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients and pour in the yeast mixture, the remaining water, and the olive oil. Attach the dough hook and knead the ingredients together on low speed for 2 minutes; the dough will start out rough and gradually become smooth. Increase the speed to medium and continue kneading for an additional 2 to 3 minutes. The dough should be relatively smooth and velvety, and beginning to pull away from the sides of the bowl.

4. Remove the dough from the bowl, and on a lightly floured board, knead the dough by hand until it is velvety smooth and elastic, about one minute or 30 strokes. Place the dough in a clean mixing bowl greased with olive oil, turning the dough once to coat it with the olive oil.

5. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and set it in a warm, draft-free area to rise until tripled in bulk, about 2 1/2 hours. (If you want the dough to rise overnight in the refrigerator, place it in an airtight plastic container, also greased with olive oil, that will be large enough to accommodate the dough when it has doubled in volume. The following day, remove the dough from the refrigerator and allow it to come to room temperature before proceeding with rolling and forming the breadsticks.)
6. Preheat the oven to 205 °C (fan 185 °C). Prepare two baking sheets by adding about 1 1/2 to 2 tbsp (22–30 ml) of additional olive oil; spread the oil out evenly on the sheets to coat.

7. Turn out the dough onto a lightly floured board and divide it into 6 even-sized pieces. Work with one piece of dough at a time, and cover the other pieces with a damp towel or plastic wrap to prevent them from drying out.

8. Cut each piece of dough into 4 or 5 portions, about the size of a walnut in its shell. If you have a scale, they should weigh 21–28 g. Form the breadsticks by rolling the pieces into a long strand with both hands, about 30–36 cm in length. Keep your fingers spread apart while you roll the breadsticks, gently stretching the dough as you roll. If the dough resists, wait a few moments and let it relax, then continue rolling and pulling gently. Resist the urge to flour the board—the tackiness of the dough will help to stretch it out evenly.

9. Place the breadstick on the oiled baking sheet and turn it, holding the ends, completely coating it with the oil. You should be able to fit 10 or 12 breadsticks on each tray; space them evenly apart by 1.3 cm. (If you decide to roll very thin breadsticks, using smaller pieces of dough, you can space them closer together, but you may need a third baking sheet.) Continue rolling the breadsticks until you have used all the dough.

10. After forming all of the breadsticks, coat them with the sesame seeds, beginning with the first one you formed as it is the most relaxed and easy to work with. Spread some of the remaining sesame seeds on your work surface in a narrow pile, about the length of the breadsticks and double the width. Holding the end of a breadstick, gently put it on top of the seeds and then turn it over once to coat the dough generously with the seeds. Return it to the baking sheet and continue until you have coated all the breadsticks with the sesame seeds. (You may have some seeds leftover).
11. Sprinkle the breadsticks with a bit of kosher salt and let them rest for about 10 minutes before baking them.

12. Bake them for 14 to 20 minutes, rotating the baking sheets halfway through the baking time to ensure even browning. The breadsticks are done when they are an even, light golden brown; the ends may brown more than the center but this is normal.
13. Allow the breadsticks to cool completely on the baking sheets. Store them in an airtight container for up to two weeks.

c.t: 1. Place 59 ml of the warm water in a small bowl and sprinkle over the yeast. Add a pinch of sugar and stir the yeast to dissolve it. Set the bowl aside to proof for 5 to 7 minutes.

2. Place the semolina and all-purpose flour in the bowl of an electric mixer along with the salt and 2 tbsp (18 g) of the sesame seeds, and stir to combine them. Check the yeast to make sure it has proofed; it will appear foamy, with bubbles forming on the surface.

3. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients and pour in the yeast mixture, the remaining water, and the olive oil. Attach the dough hook and knead the ingredients together on low speed for 2 minutes; the dough will start out rough and gradually become smooth. Increase the speed to medium and continue kneading for an additional 2 to 3 minutes. The dough should be relatively smooth and velvety, and beginning to pull away from the sides of the bowl.

4. Remove the dough from the bowl, and on a lightly floured board, knead the dough by hand until it is velvety smooth and elastic, about one minute or 30 strokes. Place the dough in a clean mixing bowl greased with olive oil, turning the dough once to coat it with the olive oil.

5. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and set it in a warm, draft-free area to rise until tripled in bulk, about 2 1/2 hours. (If you want the dough to rise overnight in the refrigerator, place it in an airtight plastic container, also greased with olive oil, that will be large enough to accommodate the dough when it has doubled in volume. The following day, remove the dough from the refrigerator and allow it to come to room temperature before proceeding with rolling and forming the breadsticks.)
6. Preheat the oven to 205 °C (fan 185 °C). Prepare two baking sheets by adding about 1 1/2 to 2 tbsp (22–30 ml) of additional olive oil; spread the oil out evenly on the sheets to coat.

7. Turn out the dough onto a lightly floured board and divide it into 6 even-sized pieces. Work with one piece of dough at a time, and cover the other pieces with a damp towel or plastic wrap to prevent them from drying out.

8. Cut each piece of dough into 4 or 5 portions, about the size of a walnut in its shell. If you have a scale, they should weigh 21–28 g. Form the breadsticks by rolling the pieces into a long strand with both hands, about 30–36 cm in length. Keep your fingers spread apart while you roll the breadsticks, gently stretching the dough as you roll. If the dough resists, wait a few moments and let it relax, then continue rolling and pulling gently. Resist the urge to flour the board—the tackiness of the dough will help to stretch it out evenly.

9. Place the breadstick on the oiled baking sheet and turn it, holding the ends, completely coating it with the oil. You should be able to fit 10 or 12 breadsticks on each tray; space them evenly apart by 1.3 cm. (If you decide to roll very thin breadsticks, using smaller pieces of dough, you can space them closer together, but you may need a third baking sheet.) Continue rolling the breadsticks until you have used all the dough.

10. After forming all of the breadsticks, coat them with the sesame seeds, beginning with the first one you formed as it is the most relaxed and easy to work with. Spread some of the remaining sesame seeds on your work surface in a narrow pile, about the length of the breadsticks and double the width. Holding the end of a breadstick, gently put it on top of the seeds and then turn it over once to coat the dough generously with the seeds. Return it to the baking sheet and continue until you have coated all the breadsticks with the sesame seeds. (You may have some seeds leftover).
11. Sprinkle the breadsticks with a bit of kosher salt and let them rest for about 10 minutes before baking them.

12. Bake them for 14 to 20 minutes, rotating the baking sheets halfway through the baking time to ensure even browning. The breadsticks are done when they are an even, light golden brown; the ends may brown more than the center but this is normal.
13. Allow the breadsticks to cool completely on the baking sheets. Store them in an airtight container for up to two weeks.
1. Do malej misky nalejeme 59 ml teplej vody a posypeme ju droždím. Pridáme štipku cukru a droždie premiešame, aby sa rozpustilo. Misku odložíme na 5 až 7 minút, aby droždie začalo pracovať.

2. Krupicu a hladkú múku dáme do misy elektrického mixéra spolu so soľou a 2 PL (18 g) sezamu a premiešame. Skontrolujeme droždie, či začalo pracovať; bude penivé a na povrchu sa budú tvoriť bublinky.

3. Do stredu suchých surovín urobíme jamku a nalejeme droždiovú zmes, zvyšnú vodu a olivový olej. Nasadíme hák na cesto a suroviny miesime na nízkej rýchlosti 2 minúty; cesto bude najprv hrubé a postupne zhladne. Zvýšime rýchlosť na strednú a miesime ďalšie 2 až 3 minúty. Cesto by malo byť pomerne hladké a zamatové a začať sa odlepovať od stien misy.

4. Cesto vyberieme z misy a na zľahka pomúčenej doske ho miesime rukou, kým nie je zamatovo hladké a pružné, asi jednu minútu alebo 30 ťahov. Cesto vložíme do čistej misy vymastenej olivovým olejom a raz ho obrátime, aby sa olejom obalilo.

5. Misu prikryjeme potravinovou fóliou a postavíme na teplé miesto bez prievanu, aby cesto kyslo, kým nestrojnásobí objem, asi 2 1/2 hodiny. (Ak chceme, aby cesto kyslo cez noc v chladničke, vložíme ho do vzduchotesnej plastovej nádoby, tiež vymastenej olivovým olejom, ktorá bude dosť veľká, aby sa do nej cesto zmestilo, keď zdvojnásobí objem. Na druhý deň cesto vyberieme z chladničky a pred vaľkaním a tvarovaním tyčiniek ho necháme zohriať na izbovú teplotu.)
6. Rúru rozohrejeme na 205 °C (teplovzdušnú na 185 °C). Pripravíme dva plechy tak, že na ne nalejeme asi 1 1/2 až 2 PL (22–30 ml) ďalšieho olivového oleja; olej rovnomerne rozotrieme po plechoch.
7. Cesto vyklopíme na zľahka pomúčenú dosku a rozdelíme na 6 rovnako veľkých kusov. Pracujeme vždy s jedným kusom cesta a ostatné prikryjeme vlhkou utierkou alebo potravinovou fóliou, aby nevyschli.

8. Každý kus cesta rozdelíme na 4 alebo 5 dielov, asi veľkosti vlašského orecha v škrupine. Ak máme váhu, mali by vážiť 21–28 g. Tyčinky tvarujeme tak, že kúsky oboma rukami vyvaľkáme na dlhý povrázok dlhý asi 30–36 cm. Pri vaľkaní tyčiniek máme prsty roztiahnuté a cesto pri vaľkaní jemne naťahujeme. Ak sa cesto bráni, chvíľu počkáme, necháme ho uvoľniť a potom pokračujeme vo vaľkaní a jemnom naťahovaní. Odoláme pokušeniu pomúčiť dosku — lepivosť cesta pomôže rovnomerne ho natiahnuť.

9. Tyčinku položíme na naolejovaný plech a za konce ju obrátime, aby sa celá obalila olejom. Na každý plech by sa nám malo zmestiť 10 alebo 12 tyčiniek; rozložíme ich rovnomerne 1,3 cm od seba. (Ak sa rozhodneme vyvaľkať veľmi tenké tyčinky z menších kúskov cesta, môžeme ich uložiť bližšie k sebe, no možno budeme potrebovať tretí plech.) Pokračujeme vo vaľkaní tyčiniek, kým nespotrebujeme všetko cesto.

10. Keď máme všetky tyčinky vytvarované, obalíme ich v sezame; začneme prvou vytvarovanou, pretože je najuvoľnenejšia a najľahšie sa s ňou pracuje. Časť zvyšného sezamu rozsypeme na pracovnú plochu do úzkeho pásu asi takého dlhého ako tyčinky a dvakrát takého širokého. Tyčinku chytíme za koniec, jemne ju položíme na semienka a raz ju obrátime, aby sa cesto výdatne obalilo. Vrátime ju na plech a pokračujeme, kým neobalíme všetky tyčinky. (Môže nám zostať trochu semienok.)
11. Tyčinky posypeme trochou hrubej soli a pred pečením ich necháme asi 10 minút odpočívať.

12. Pečieme 14 až 20 minút; v polovici pečenia plechy otočíme, aby sa tyčinky rovnomerne opiekli. Tyčinky sú hotové, keď sú rovnomerne svetlo zlatistohnedé; konce môžu byť tmavšie ako stred, ale to je normálne.
13. Tyčinky necháme úplne vychladnúť na plechoch. Uchovávame ich vo vzduchotesnej nádobe najviac dva týždne.

cat.en: Roll the breadsticks thin and even and bake them until fully dry and crisp; thicker or uneven sticks stay soft in the middle.
cat.sk: Tyčinky rozvaľkajte natenko a rovnomerne a pečte ich, kým nie sú úplne suché a chrumkavé; hrubšie alebo nerovné zostanú v strede mäkké.

tip.en: Roll each breadstick through a narrow line of sesame seeds on the counter, starting with the first one you shaped, since its dough is the most relaxed.
tip.sk: Každú tyčinku vyváľajte v úzkom pásiku sezamových semienok na doske, začnite tou, ktorú ste vytvarovali ako prvú, pretože jej cesto je najuvoľnenejšie.

sk.t: 6 tbsp (85 g) butter, room temperature at least 20 °C

en.t: 1. Weigh your flour. Combine all of the ingredients, and mix and knead — using your hands, a mixer, or a bread machine set on the dough cycle — to form a smooth, soft dough.

2. Transfer the dough to a lightly greased bowl or dough-rising bucket, cover the bowl or bucket, and allow the dough to rise until puffy though not necessarily doubled in bulk, about 1 1/2 hours, depending on the warmth of your kitchen.

3. Lightly grease a 33 cm pain de mie pan. Gently deflate the dough, transfer it to a lightly greased work surface, shape it into a 33 cm log, and fit it into the pan. Cover the pan with lightly greased plastic wrap, and allow the dough to rise until it's just below the lip of the pan, 45 minutes to 1 hour, depending on the warmth of your kitchen (it may rise even more slowly in a cool kitchen; don't worry, this long rise will give it great flavor).
4. Towards the end of the rising time, preheat the oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C).

5. Remove the plastic, and place the cover on the pan. Bake the bread for 25 minutes. Remove the pan from the oven, carefully remove the lid, and return the bread to the oven to bake for an additional 10 to 20 minutes, or until it tests done; a digital thermometer inserted into the center will register 90 °C.
6. Remove the bread from the oven, and turn it out of the pan onto a rack to cool completely.
7. Store, wrapped, at room temperature for 4 days, or freeze for up to 3 months.

1. Múku odvážime. Všetky suroviny spojíme, zmiešame a vymiesime — rukami, mixérom alebo v domácej pekárni na programe na cesto — aby vzniklo hladké, mäkké cesto.
2. Cesto preložíme do zľahka vymastenej misy alebo nádoby na kysnutie, prikryjeme a necháme kysnúť, kým nie je nadýchané, hoci nemusí zdvojnásobiť objem, asi 1 1/2 hodiny podľa teploty v kuchyni.

3. Formu na pain de mie s dĺžkou 33 cm zľahka vymastíme. Cesto jemne prepučíme, preložíme na zľahka vymastenú pracovnú plochu, vytvarujeme do valca dlhého 33 cm a vložíme do formy. Formu prikryjeme zľahka vymastenou potravinovou fóliou a cesto necháme kysnúť, kým nesiaha tesne pod okraj formy, 45 minút až 1 hodinu podľa teploty v kuchyni (v chladnej kuchyni môže kysnúť ešte pomalšie; nevadí, dlhé kysnutie mu dodá skvelú chuť).
4. Ku koncu kysnutia rozohrejeme rúru na 175 °C (teplovzdušnú na 155 °C).

5. Odstránime fóliu a formu zakryjeme vekom. Chlieb pečieme 25 minút. Formu vyberieme z rúry, opatrne odstránime veko a chlieb vrátime do rúry piecť ďalších 10 až 20 minút, alebo kým nie je hotový; digitálny teplomer zapichnutý do stredu ukáže 90 °C.
6. Chlieb vyberieme z rúry, vyklopíme ho z formy na mriežku a necháme úplne vychladnúť.
7. Zabalený uchovávame pri izbovej teplote 4 dni alebo zamrazený najviac 3 mesiace.

cat.sk: Chlieb pečte vo forme s vekom, aby boli krajce dokonale hranaté, a veko nasuňte, keď cesto vykysne asi 1 cm pod okraj.

en.t: 340 g water, lukewarm
227 g milk, lukewarm
2 tbsp (28 g) butter, melted
420 g King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
2 1/2 tsp (7.5 g) instant yeast
1 tsp (4 g) baking powder
1 1/4 tsp (8 g) table salt
1. Weigh your flour. Combine all of the ingredients in a bowl, and beat vigorously for 2 minutes. A stand or hand mixer, set on high speed, work well here.

2. Cover the bowl, and let the batter rest at room temperature for 1 hour. It will expand and become bubbly. Towards the end of the rest, preheat a griddle to medium-low, about 165 °C. If you don't have an electric griddle, preheat a frying pan; it shouldn't be as hot as the temperature you use to cook pancakes.

3. Lightly grease the griddle or frying pan, and place well-greased 9.5 cm English muffin rings in the pan, as many as will fit. Pour a scant 60 ml of sticky batter into each ring; a muffin scoop works well here.

4. After about 4 minutes, use a pair of tongs to slip the rings off. Cook the crumpets for a total of about 10 minutes on the first side, until their tops are riddled with small bubbles/holes. They should be starting to look a bit dry around the edges. Their bottoms will be a mottled, light-golden brown. Note: They probably won't be as full of holes as store-bought crumpets; that's OK.

5. Turn the crumpets over, and cook for an additional 5 minutes, to finish cooking the insides and to brown the tops gently. This isn't traditional; "real" crumpets are white on top, but the crumpet police won't chastise you for adding a little color to the tops.

6. Remove the crumpets from the pan, and repeat with the remaining batter, until all the crumpets are cooked. Serve warm. Or cool completely, wrap in plastic, and store at room temperature. To enjoy, warm in the toaster. Serve with butter, or butter and jam.

1. Múku odvážime. Všetky suroviny spojíme v mise a energicky šľaháme 2 minúty. Dobre poslúži stojanový alebo ručný mixér na vysokej rýchlosti.

2. Misu prikryjeme a cesto necháme 1 hodinu odpočívať pri izbovej teplote. Zväčší objem a bude bublinkové. Ku koncu odpočívania rozohrejeme platňu na mierny až stredný stupeň, asi 165 °C. Ak nemáme elektrickú platňu, rozohrejeme panvicu; nemala by byť taká horúca ako pri pečení palaciniek.

3. Platňu alebo panvicu zľahka vymastíme a položíme na ňu dobre vymastené krúžky na anglické muffiny s priemerom 9,5 cm, koľko sa ich zmestí. Do každého krúžku nalejeme necelých 60 ml lepkavého cesta; dobre poslúži naberačka na muffiny.

4. Asi po 4 minútach krúžky kliešťami stiahneme. Crumpety pečieme z prvej strany spolu asi 10 minút, kým nie je ich vrch posiaty drobnými bublinkami a dierkami. Na okrajoch by mali začať vyzerať trochu suché. Spodok bude škvrnitý, svetlo zlatistohnedý. Poznámka: pravdepodobne nebudú také deravé ako kupované crumpety; to nevadí.

5. Crumpety obrátime a pečieme ďalších 5 minút, aby sa dopiekli vnútri a vrch sa jemne opiekol. Nie je to tradičné; „pravé“ crumpety sú navrchu biele, ale crumpetová polícia nás nepokarhá, ak vrchu dodáme trochu farby.

6. Crumpety vyberieme z panvice a postup opakujeme so zvyšným cestom, kým neupečieme všetky. Podávame teplé. Alebo ich necháme úplne vychladnúť, zabalíme do fólie a uchovávame pri izbovej teplote. Pred jedením ich zohrejeme v hriankovači. Podávame s maslom alebo s maslom a džemom.

cat.en: You can make crumpets without rings, but rings give them a neat, perfectly round shape.
cat.sk: Lievance crumpets sa dajú piecť aj bez krúžkov, ale s krúžkami budú úhľadne okrúhle.

src: King Arthur Baking — PJ Hamel — "Scones"

en.t: 330 g King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
67 g granulated sugar
3/4 tsp (4.5 g) table salt
1 tbsp (12 g) baking powder
8 tbsp (113 g) unsalted butter, cold
170 g to 340 g chopped dried fruit, chocolate or other flavored chips, nuts, Jammy Bits*, or a combination, optional
2 large eggs (≈100 g without shell)
2 tsp (10 ml) King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract, or the flavoring of your choice
113–152 g half-and-half or milk
2 tsp (10 ml) milk
2 tbsp (24 g) coarse sparkling sugar or cinnamon sugar, optional

sk.t: 170–340 g nasekané sušené ovocie, čokoládové či iné ochutené kúsky, orechy, Jammy Bits* alebo ich kombinácia, nepovinné
2 tsp (10 ml) King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract, or the flavoring of your choice
2 tbsp (24 g) coarse sparkling sugar or cinnamon sugar, optional

en.t: 1. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, salt, and baking powder.
2. Work in the butter just until the mixture is unevenly crumbly; it's OK for some larger chunks of butter to remain unincorporated.
3. Stir in the fruit, chips, and/or nuts, if you're using them.
4. In a separate mixing bowl, whisk together the eggs, vanilla or other flavor, and half-and-half or milk. Add the liquid ingredients to the dry ingredients.
5. Using a bowl scraper or a large spoon, stir the dough ingredients until all is moistened and holds together.
6. Line a baking sheet with parchment; if you don't have parchment, just use it without greasing it. Sprinkle a bit of flour atop the parchment or pan.

7. Scrape the dough onto the floured parchment or pan, and divide it in half. Round each half into a 13 cm circle (if you haven't incorporated any add-ins); or a 15 cm circle (if you've added fruit, nuts, etc.). The circles should be about 2 cm thick.
8. Using a knife or bench knife that you've run under cold water, slice each circle into 6 wedges.
9. Brush each circle with milk, and sprinkle with coarse white sparkling sugar or cinnamon sugar.
10. Carefully pull the wedges away from the center to separate them just a bit; there should be about 1.5 cm space between them, at their outer edges.

11. For best texture and highest rise, place the pan of scones in the freezer for 30 minutes, uncovered. Chilling the scones relaxes the gluten in the flour, which makes the scones more tender and allows them to rise higher. It also chills the fat, which will make the scones a bit flakier. While the scones are chilling, preheat the oven to 220 °C (fan 200 °C) with a rack in the upper third.

12. Bake the scones in the upper part of your oven for 18 to 23 minutes, or until they're a light golden brown. When you pull one away from the others, it should look baked all the way through; the edge shouldn't look wet or unbaked.
13. Remove the scones from the oven, and cool briefly on the pan. Serve warm. They're delicious as is, but add butter and/or jam, if you like.

14. When the scones are completely cool, wrap them in plastic and store at room temperature for up to several days. To reheat room-temperature scones, place on a baking sheet, tent lightly with foil, and warm in a preheated 175 °C (fan 155 °C) oven for about 10 minutes.

1. Vo veľkej mise metličkou premiešame múku, cukor, soľ a prášok do pečiva.
2. Zapracujeme maslo, len kým zmes nie je nerovnomerne drobivá; nevadí, ak niektoré väčšie kúsky masla zostanú nezapracované.
3. Ak ich používame, vmiešame ovocie, kúsky čokolády a/alebo orechy.
4. V samostatnej mise metličkou zmiešame vajcia, vanilku alebo inú arómu a zmes mlieka so smotanou alebo mlieko. Tekuté suroviny pridáme k suchým.
5. Škrabkou alebo veľkou lyžicou miešame suroviny na cesto, kým sa všetko nezvlhčí a nedrží pohromade.
6. Plech vystelieme papierom na pečenie; ak papier nemáme, použijeme plech bez vymastenia. Papier alebo plech posypeme trochou múky.

7. Cesto zoškrabeme na pomúčený papier alebo plech a rozdelíme na polovicu. Každú polovicu vytvarujeme do kruhu s priemerom 13 cm (ak sme nepridali nijaké prísady); alebo s priemerom 15 cm (ak sme pridali ovocie, orechy a pod.). Kruhy by mali byť hrubé asi 2 cm.
8. Nožom alebo škrabkou, ktorú sme opláchli studenou vodou, rozkrojíme každý kruh na 6 klinov.
9. Každý kruh potrieme mliekom a posypeme hrubým bielym zdobiacim cukrom alebo škoricovým cukrom.
10. Kliny opatrne odtiahneme od stredu, aby sa trochu oddelili; na vonkajších okrajoch by medzi nimi malo byť asi 1,5 cm miesta.

11. Pre najlepšiu štruktúru a najvyššie nakysnutie dáme plech so sconami odkrytý na 30 minút do mrazničky. Chladenie uvoľní lepok v múke, vďaka čomu budú scony jemnejšie a vyššie nakysnú. Zároveň sa vychladí tuk, takže scony budú o niečo lístkovejšie. Kým sa scony chladia, rozohrejeme rúru na 220 °C (teplovzdušnú na 200 °C) s roštom v hornej tretine.

12. Scony pečieme v hornej časti rúry 18 až 23 minút, alebo kým nie sú svetlo zlatistohnedé. Keď jeden odtiahneme od ostatných, mal by vyzerať prepečený celý; okraj by nemal vyzerať mokrý ani nedopečený.
13. Scony vyberieme z rúry a necháme krátko chladnúť na plechu. Podávame teplé. Sú výborné aj samotné, ale podľa chuti pridáme maslo a/alebo džem.

14. Keď scony úplne vychladnú, zabalíme ich do fólie a uchovávame pri izbovej teplote najviac niekoľko dní. Scony izbovej teploty prehrejeme tak, že ich položíme na plech, voľne prikryjeme alobalom a ohrievame v rúre rozohriatej na 175 °C (teplovzdušnej na 155 °C) asi 10 minút.

src: Serious Eats — Stella Parks — "Light and Fluffy Biscuits Recipe"

en.v: 4.5 cm round cutter (or similar), 25 cm cast iron skillet

sk.v: Okrúhla vykrajovačka 4,5 cm (alebo podobná), liatinová panvica 25 cm

c.t: Use plain, unsweetened, unstrained yogurt containing only cultured milk; Greek yogurt or yogurt with thickeners, gums or stabilisers makes gummy biscuits.
Použite biely nesladený neprecedený jogurt, ktorý obsahuje len kultivované mlieko; grécky jogurt alebo jogurt so zahusťovadlami, gumami či stabilizátormi urobí sušienky gumovité.

en.t: 255 g all-purpose flour, such as Gold Medal (spooned)
15 g sugar (about 1 tbsp)
1 tbsp (12 g) baking powder
1/2 tsp (3 g) baking soda
1 1/2 tsp (6 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use about half as much by volume or the same weight
110 g cold unsalted butter, cut into 1.5 cm cubes (about 8 tbsp)
255 g plain yogurt, straight from the fridge

sk.t: 255 g hladká múka, napr. Gold Medal (do odmerky nasypaná lyžicou)
1 ½ ČL (6 g) hrubozrnná soľ Diamond Crystal (pri jemnej soli dáme objemovo asi polovicu, hmotnostne rovnako)
110 g cold unsalted butter, cut into 1.5 cm cubes (about 8 tbsp)
255 g plain yogurt, straight from the fridge

en.t: 1. Adjust oven rack to lower-middle position and preheat to 200 °C (fan 180 °C). Should your kitchen be warmer than 24 °C, work quickly and keep the butter and yogurt cold until they go in.

2. Sift flour into a medium bowl, then add sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt; whisk until well combined (this may take up to 1 minute). Add butter, toss to break up the pieces, and smash each cube flat. Continue smashing and rubbing until butter has mostly disappeared into a floury mix, although a few larger, Cheerio-sized pieces may remain. This can also be done with 4 or 5 pulses in a food processor, just take care not to overdo it. The prepared mix can be refrigerated up to 3 weeks in an airtight container, then used as directed below.

3. Add yogurt, and stir with a flexible spatula until the flour has been fully absorbed. The dough will seem rather crumbly and dry at first, but keep mixing until it finally comes together (don't worry about over-mixing; until the flour has been fully incorporated, the greater concern is under-mixing). Once the dough forms a rough ball, turn out onto a lightly floured surface.

4. With your bare hands, gently pat the dough into a squarish shape about 1.5 cm thick, then fold in half; repeat twice more for a total of 3 folds, using only enough flour to keep your hands from sticking. Finish by patting the dough to a thickness of 2 cm. If needed, dust away any excess flour, then cut into 4.5 cm rounds and arrange in a 25 cm cast iron skillet. Gather scraps into a ball, pat and fold a single time, then cut as many more biscuits as you can. The final round of scraps can be gathered and shaped into a single biscuit by hand.

5. Bake until the biscuits are well-risen and golden brown, about 20 minutes. Let the biscuits cool about 5 minutes to help set their crumb, then serve as desired, whether alongside soups and stews or split for shortcake or breakfast sandwiches. Leftovers can be stored up to a week in an airtight container; to serve, split the stale biscuits in half, brush with melted butter, arrange on a baking sheet, and broil until golden brown, then serve with jam.

1. Rošt nastavíme do polohy pod stredom rúry a rúru rozohrejeme na 200 °C (teplovzdušnú na 180 °C). Ak je v kuchyni teplejšie ako 24 °C, pracujeme rýchlo a maslo a jogurt necháme studené, kým ich nepridáme.

2. Múku preosejeme do stredne veľkej misy, potom pridáme cukor, prášok do pečiva, sódu bikarbónu a soľ; metličkou miešame, kým sa dobre nespoja (môže to trvať až 1 minútu). Pridáme maslo, premiešame, aby sa kúsky oddelili, a každú kocku stlačíme naplocho. Pokračujeme v stláčaní a mrvení, kým maslo takmer nezmizne v múčnej zmesi, hoci niekoľko väčších kúskov veľkosti cereálnych krúžkov môže zostať. Dá sa to urobiť aj 4 alebo 5 pulzmi v kuchynskom robote, len dávame pozor, aby sme to neprehnali. Pripravenú zmes môžeme uchovávať v chladničke vo vzduchotesnej nádobe najviac 3 týždne a potom ju použiť podľa postupu nižšie.

3. Pridáme jogurt a pružnou stierkou miešame, kým sa múka úplne nevstrebe. Cesto sa spočiatku bude zdať dosť drobivé a suché, ale miešame ďalej, kým sa napokon nespojí (premiešania sa nebojíme; kým nie je všetka múka zapracovaná, väčším problémom je nedostatočné premiešanie). Keď cesto vytvorí hrubú guľu, vyklopíme ho na zľahka pomúčenú plochu.

4. Holými rukami cesto jemne rozklepeme do približne štvorcového tvaru hrubého asi 1,5 cm, potom ho preložíme na polovicu; zopakujeme ešte dvakrát, spolu 3 preloženia, a múky použijeme len toľko, aby sa nám nelepilo na ruky. Nakoniec cesto rozklepeme na hrúbku 2 cm. Ak treba, zmetieme prebytočnú múku, potom vykrojíme kolieska s priemerom 4,5 cm a uložíme ich do liatinovej panvice s priemerom 25 cm. Zvyšky spojíme do gule, rozklepeme a raz preložíme, potom vykrojíme ďalšie biscuity, koľko sa dá. Poslednú dávku zvyškov môžeme spojiť a rukou vytvarovať do jedného biscuitu.

5. Pečieme, kým biscuity dobre nenakysnú a nie sú zlatistohnedé, asi 20 minút. Biscuity necháme asi 5 minút chladnúť, aby sa ustálila striedka, potom podávame podľa chuti, či už k polievkam a duseným jedlám, alebo prekrojené na shortcake či raňajkové sendviče. Zvyšky môžeme uchovávať vo vzduchotesnej nádobe najviac týždeň; pred podávaním staršie biscuity prekrojíme na polovicu, potrieme rozpusteným maslom, uložíme na plech a zapečieme pod grilom do zlatistohneda, potom podávame s džemom.

en.t: 900 g King Arthur Unbleached Bread Flour
100 g King Arthur Whole Wheat Flour or King Arthur Golden Wheat Flour
800 g tepid water (about 25 °C)
1 tbsp (20 g) table salt
3 tbsp (40 g) sourdough starter, unfed/discard

sk.t: 100 g celozrnná pšeničná múka King Arthur alebo King Arthur Golden Wheat Flour

en.t: 1. Combine all the ingredients in a large bowl or extra large (5680 ml) dough rising bucket. It's fine to use sourdough starter straight from the refrigerator if that's where you keep it, though it's best if you've fed it at least once in the past week.
2. Mix the ingredients by hand until the dough forms a shaggy mass and the flour is hydrated. Cover the bowl or bucket and let the dough rest at room temperature for 15 minutes.

3. Fold the dough by grabbing a section from one side with a wet hand, lifting it up, then pressing it down to the middle to seal. Repeat this with the remaining three sides of the dough. Cover and let it rest for 15 minutes.

4. Fold the dough two more times, giving it a 15-minute rest between the two, for a total of three sets of folds in 45 minutes. As you perform the folds you’ll notice that the dough smooths out, gaining strength and becoming elastic.

5. Cover the dough tightly after the final fold and leave it at room temperature (approximately 20 °C) for about 12 hours. It's helpful to mark the height of the dough (use the markings on the bucket or a large rubber band around your bowl) to gauge how much it rises.

6. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured or greased surface and divide it into two roughly equal pieces. Gently form the pieces into rounds, cover them, and let them rest seam-side down for 10 minutes.
7. Generously dust two lined brotforms or towel-lined large bowls with whole wheat flour.
8. Shape the loaves into tight rounds (boules), place them seam-side up into the prepared brotforms or bowls, and cover them with a plastic bag or shower cap.

9. If your dough doubled (or came close to doubling) during the 12-hour rise period, immediately place the boules into the refrigerator. But if your dough was a bit more sluggish, let the boules rest at room temperature for 30 to 60 minutes to give them a head start on the second rise.
10. Let the boules rest in the refrigerator for 8 to 12 hours, depending on your schedule (not theirs!).

11. When you're ready to bake, place two Dutch ovens or other lidded bread bakers onto a rack set in the lowest third of the oven. If you just have one Dutch oven or don't have room for two in your oven, you can certainly bake one loaf at a time, leaving the other in the refrigerator while the first one bakes. Preheat the oven (and Dutch ovens) to 260 °C (fan 240 °C) for 45 minutes (you'll want to ensure that they're tough enough to withstand preheating; not all are).
12. Turn each loaf out onto a piece of parchment paper and slash them with a lame or sharp knife.
13. Remove the preheated Dutch ovens from the oven. With the help of the parchment, carefully transfer the loaves to the Dutch ovens.
14. Cover the Dutch ovens with their lids and place them in the oven.

15. Immediately reduce the oven temperature to 230 °C (fan 210 °C) and bake the covered loaves for 20 minutes. Remove the lids from the Dutch ovens and bake the loaves for 20 to 25 minutes uncovered, until they're a deep golden brown.

16. Remove the loaves from the oven and carefully turn them out of the Dutch ovens onto racks to cool completely. If you're baking one loaf at a time repeat the process with the second loaf, preheating the Dutch oven if necessary.
17. Store leftover bread, loosely wrapped, for several days; freeze for longer storage.

1. Všetky suroviny spojíme vo veľkej mise alebo v extra veľkej (5680 ml) nádobe na kysnutie cesta. Kvások môžeme použiť rovno z chladničky, ak ho tam uchovávame, hoci najlepšie je, ak sme ho za posledný týždeň aspoň raz nakŕmili.
2. Suroviny miešame rukou, kým cesto nevytvorí strapatú hmotu a múka nie je zvlhčená. Misu alebo nádobu prikryjeme a cesto necháme 15 minút odpočívať pri izbovej teplote.

3. Cesto preložíme tak, že mokrou rukou chytíme časť z jednej strany, zdvihneme ju a potom ju pritlačíme do stredu, aby sa spojila. Zopakujeme so zvyšnými tromi stranami cesta. Prikryjeme a necháme 15 minút odpočívať.
4. Cesto preložíme ešte dvakrát, medzi nimi ho necháme 15 minút odpočívať, takže spolu urobíme tri série preložení za 45 minút. Pri prekladaní si všimneme, že cesto zhladne, zosilnie a je pružné.

5. Po poslednom preložení cesto tesne prikryjeme a necháme ho pri izbovej teplote (približne 20 °C) asi 12 hodín. Pomôže, ak si označíme výšku cesta (stupnicou na nádobe alebo veľkou gumičkou okolo misy), aby sme vedeli posúdiť, o koľko nakyslo.
6. Cesto vyklopíme na zľahka pomúčenú alebo vymastenú plochu a rozdelíme na dva zhruba rovnaké kusy. Kusy jemne vytvarujeme do guliek, prikryjeme ich a necháme 10 minút odpočívať spojom nadol.
7. Dva vystlané ošatky alebo veľké misy vystlané utierkou výdatne poprášime celozrnnou múkou.
8. Bochníky vytvarujeme do pevných guľatých bochníkov (boules), vložíme ich spojom nahor do pripravených ošatiek alebo mís a prikryjeme igelitovým vreckom alebo kúpacou čiapkou.

9. Ak cesto počas 12 hodín kysnutia zdvojnásobilo objem (alebo sa tomu priblížilo), bochníky hneď dáme do chladničky. Ak však bolo cesto trochu lenivejšie, necháme bochníky 30 až 60 minút odpočívať pri izbovej teplote, aby sme im dali náskok pri druhom kysnutí.
10. Bochníky necháme v chladničke odpočívať 8 až 12 hodín podľa nášho časového plánu (nie ich!).

11. Keď sme pripravení piecť, postavíme dva liatinové hrnce alebo iné nádoby na pečenie chleba s pokrievkou na rošt v dolnej tretine rúry. Ak máme len jeden liatinový hrniec alebo sa nám do rúry dva nezmestia, môžeme pokojne piecť po jednom bochníku a druhý necháme v chladničke, kým sa pečie prvý. Rúru (aj hrnce) rozohrejeme na 260 °C (teplovzdušnú na 240 °C) na 45 minút (overíme si, že hrnce sú dosť odolné, aby predhrievanie zniesli; nie všetky sú).
12. Každý bochník vyklopíme na kus papiera na pečenie a narežeme ho žiletkou alebo ostrým nožom.
13. Rozohriate hrnce vyberieme z rúry. Pomocou papiera opatrne preložíme bochníky do hrncov.
14. Hrnce prikryjeme pokrievkami a vložíme do rúry.

15. Teplotu rúry hneď znížime na 230 °C (teplovzdušnú na 210 °C) a prikryté bochníky pečieme 20 minút. Z hrncov odstránime pokrievky a bochníky pečieme odkryté 20 až 25 minút, kým nie sú sýto zlatistohnedé.
16. Bochníky vyberieme z rúry, opatrne ich vyklopíme z hrncov na mriežky a necháme úplne vychladnúť. Ak pečieme po jednom bochníku, postup zopakujeme s druhým; ak treba, hrniec znova rozohrejeme.
17. Zvyšný chlieb voľne zabalený uchovávame niekoľko dní; na dlhšie skladovanie ho zamrazíme.

cat.sk: Recept je na dva veľké bochníky; ak chcete upiecť len jeden, jednoducho všetky suroviny znížte na polovicu.

en.t: 120 g King Arthur Unbleached Bread Flour

1 tbsp (14 g) butter
142 g onions, diced
71 g Kalamata olives, pitted and roughly chopped
113 g water
120 g King Arthur Unbleached Bread Flour
113 g King Arthur Whole Wheat Flour
2 tsp (6 g) instant yeast
1 tsp (6 g) table salt
2 tbsp (25 g) olive oil

sk.t: 71 g olivy Kalamata, bez kôstok a nahrubo nasekané
113 g celozrnná pšeničná múka King Arthur

en.t: 1. To make the poolish: Weigh your flour.
2. Combine the flour, water and yeast, and set aside to rest, covered, overnight.

3. To prepare the filling: Combine the butter and diced onions in a pan set over medium-low heat. Cook the onions for about 20 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes; they should be nicely caramelized. Transfer the onions to a bowl and cool to room temperature before using.
4. To make the dough: Weigh or carefully measure your flours. Add the 113 g water and flours to the poolish, mix until shaggy, cover the bowl, and allow the mixture to rest for 20 minutes.

5. Add the yeast, salt, and olive oil and knead the dough briefly, until it's a shaggy mass. Mix in the caramelized onions and olives and knead the dough until it's fairly supple but not necessarily elastic, about 3 minutes with a stand mixer or 5 minutes by hand.
6. Place the dough in a lightly greased bowl, cover the bowl, and allow the dough to rise at room temperature for 1 1/2 hours, gently deflating it and turning it over after 45 minutes.
7. To shape the bread: Shape the dough into a 30 × 15 cm oval, place it on a lightly greased baking sheet, and allow it to rise for about 30 minutes.

8. Using a sharp knife or pair of scissors, cut a single slit all the way through the dough lengthwise down the center, stopping about 2.5 cm from each end. Follow up with three or four diagonal slits on each side of the center slit.

9. To create a leaf-like appearance, open up each slit by gently stretching the dough with your fingers, leaving behind holes that are at least 5 cm wide. This will ensure the leaf design is visible after the dough rises.
10. Allow the fougasse to rise until noticeably puffy, about 30 to 45 minutes.
11. Toward the end of the rising time, preheat the oven to 205 °C (fan 185 °C). For extra-crispy crust, place a baking stone on the center rack.
12. Bake the fougasse for 20 minutes or until it turns golden brown. Remove it from the oven and transfer to a rack to cool.
13. Store bread, well-wrapped, at room temperature for three days; freeze for up to a month.

1. Príprava poolishu: múku odvážime.
2. Múku, vodu a droždie spojíme a necháme prikryté odpočívať cez noc.

3. Príprava plnky: maslo a na kocky nakrájanú cibuľu dáme do panvice na mierny až stredný oheň. Cibuľu restujeme asi 20 minút a každých 5 minút premiešame; mala by byť pekne skaramelizovaná. Cibuľu preložíme do misky a pred použitím necháme vychladnúť na izbovú teplotu.
4. Príprava cesta: múky odvážime alebo starostlivo odmeriame. K poolishu pridáme 113 g vody a múky, premiešame na strapatú hmotu, misu prikryjeme a necháme zmes 20 minút odpočívať.

5. Pridáme droždie, soľ a olivový olej a cesto krátko premiesime na strapatú hmotu. Vmiešame karamelizovanú cibuľu a olivy a cesto miesime, kým nie je pomerne poddajné, hoci nie nevyhnutne pružné, asi 3 minúty v stojanovom mixéri alebo 5 minút rukou.
6. Cesto vložíme do zľahka vymastenej misy, misu prikryjeme a cesto necháme kysnúť pri izbovej teplote 1 1/2 hodiny; po 45 minútach ho jemne prepučíme a obrátime.
7. Tvarovanie chleba: cesto vytvarujeme do oválu s rozmermi 30 × 15 cm, položíme na zľahka vymastený plech a necháme kysnúť asi 30 minút.

8. Ostrým nožom alebo nožnicami urobíme pozdĺž stredu jeden zárez cez celé cesto, pričom asi 2,5 cm od oboch koncov prestaneme. Potom urobíme po oboch stranách stredového zárezu tri alebo štyri šikmé zárezy.
9. Aby fougasse vyzerala ako list, každý zárez roztvoríme jemným naťahovaním cesta prstami, aby vznikli otvory široké aspoň 5 cm. Tak bude vzor listu viditeľný aj po nakysnutí cesta.
10. Fougasse necháme kysnúť, kým nie je viditeľne nadýchaná, asi 30 až 45 minút.
11. Ku koncu kysnutia rozohrejeme rúru na 205 °C (teplovzdušnú na 185 °C). Pre extra chrumkavú kôrku položíme na stredný rošt kameň na pečenie.
12. Fougasse pečieme 20 minút alebo kým nie je zlatistohnedá. Vyberieme ju z rúry a preložíme na mriežku vychladnúť.
13. Chlieb dobre zabalený uchovávame pri izbovej teplote tri dni; zamrazený najviac mesiac.

en.t: 1. Combine 227 g of the water with the cornmeal in a saucepan and cook over low heat until thick, stirring often (about 5 minutes). Remove the pan from heat and add the molasses, butter, salt, sugar, caraway seeds and cocoa powder. Stir to combine and set aside to cool to lukewarm.
2. Put the remaining 113 g water in a large mixing bowl and add the yeast.
3. Add the molasses mixture and mashed potatoes.
4. Weigh your flour. Stir in the pumpernickel and whole wheat flour. Mix and knead the dough at medium speed for 10 minutes.
5. Transfer the dough to a greased bowl. Sprinkle the top with flour. Cover the bowl and let rise until the dough is not quite doubled; about 1 hour.
6. When the dough is risen, it will have expanded and you'll see cracks in the flour you sprinkled.
7. Shape the dough into a loaf and place in a greased 22 × 11 cm loaf pan. Sprinkle the top with more flour or brush with a mixture of 1 egg white beaten with 1 tbsp (15 ml) water.

8. Once the dough is shaped, slash the top in a decorative design, and bake in a preheated 190 °C (fan 170 °C) oven for 55 to 65 minutes, until the center reaches 95 °C when measured with a digital thermometer. (That's right, there's no second rise before baking with this traditional style of pumpernickel bread. It gives the bread its dense, close-grained crumb.) Remove from the oven, tip out of the pan, and cool on a rack completely before slicing.
9. Store at room temperature, well wrapped, for several days; freeze for longer storage.

c.t: 1. Combine 227 g of the water with the cornmeal in a saucepan and cook over low heat until thick, stirring often (about 5 minutes). Remove the pan from heat and add the molasses, butter, salt, sugar, caraway seeds and cocoa powder. Stir to combine and set aside to cool to lukewarm.
2. Put the remaining 113 g water in a large mixing bowl and add the yeast.
3. Add the molasses mixture and mashed potatoes.
4. Weigh your flour. Stir in the pumpernickel and whole wheat flour. Mix and knead the dough at medium speed for 10 minutes.
5. Transfer the dough to a greased bowl. Sprinkle the top with flour. Cover the bowl and let rise until the dough is not quite doubled; about 1 hour.
6. When the dough is risen, it will have expanded and you'll see cracks in the flour you sprinkled.
7. Shape the dough into a loaf and place in a greased 22 × 11 cm loaf pan. Sprinkle the top with more flour or brush with a mixture of 1 egg white beaten with 1 tbsp (15 ml) water.

8. Once the dough is shaped, slash the top in a decorative design, and bake in a preheated 190 °C (fan 170 °C) oven for 55 to 65 minutes, until the center reaches 95 °C when measured with a digital thermometer. (That's right, there's no second rise before baking with this traditional style of pumpernickel bread. It gives the bread its dense, close-grained crumb.) Remove from the oven, tip out of the pan, and cool on a rack completely before slicing.
9. Store at room temperature, well wrapped, for several days; freeze for longer storage.

1. V hrnci spojíme 227 g vody s kukuričnou múkou a za častého miešania varíme na miernom ohni, kým nezhustne (asi 5 minút). Hrniec odstavíme z ohňa a pridáme melasu, maslo, soľ, cukor, rasce a kakao. Premiešame, aby sa spojili, a odložíme vychladnúť na vlažnú teplotu.
2. Zvyšných 113 g vody nalejeme do veľkej misy a pridáme droždie.
3. Pridáme melasovú zmes a zemiakovú kašu.
4. Múku odvážime. Vmiešame ražnú šrotovú (pumpernickel) a celozrnnú múku. Cesto miešame a miesime na strednej rýchlosti 10 minút.
5. Cesto preložíme do vymastenej misy. Vrch posypeme múkou. Misu prikryjeme a necháme kysnúť, kým cesto celkom nezdvojnásobí objem; asi 1 hodinu.
6. Keď cesto nakysne, zväčší objem a v múke, ktorou sme ho posypali, uvidíme praskliny.
7. Cesto vytvarujeme do bochníka a vložíme do vymastenej formy na chlieb s rozmermi 22 × 11 cm. Vrch posypeme ďalšou múkou alebo potrieme zmesou 1 bielka rozšľahaného s 1 PL (15 ml) vody.

8. Keď je cesto vytvarované, vrch ozdobne narežeme a pečieme v rúre rozohriatej na 190 °C (teplovzdušnej na 170 °C) 55 až 65 minút, kým stred nedosiahne 95 °C meraných digitálnym teplomerom. (Áno, pri tomto tradičnom type chleba pumpernickel nie je pred pečením druhé kysnutie. Vďaka tomu má chlieb hustú, jemne pórovitú striedku.) Vyberieme z rúry, vyklopíme z formy a pred krájaním necháme úplne vychladnúť na mriežke.
9. Dobre zabalený uchovávame pri izbovej teplote niekoľko dní; na dlhšie skladovanie ho zamrazíme.

c.t: The recipe was developed by weight; use a scale. Instant yeast need not be bloomed. Glutinous (sweet) rice flour is sold in supermarkets, Asian markets and online, or grind sweet sticky rice very fine; do not use regular white rice flour.

If the scald in step 1 is below 70 °C, microwave it covered in 30-second bursts, whisking each time, until it thickens and reaches 70 °C; or whisk it in a small nonstick skillet over medium-low heat. Do not overcook; transfer to a bowl and continue with step 2.
The overnight cold proof is optional but adds flavour; chilling before shaping is essential, as it makes the sticky dough manageable.

The recipe fits a straight-sided 23 × 10 × 10 cm loaf pan. In a smaller flared pan, or a covered pullman pan, reduce each dough ball to 200 g and bake the leftover dough as a bun on a small greased pan beside the loaf until golden, 17 to 20 minutes.

For a lidded loaf, proof until the top is 1 cm above the rim, bake covered for 30 minutes, then uncovered until well browned and at least 88 °C inside, 20 to 30 minutes more. The melted butter is brushed on top only when baking without a lid (or on the bun).

Recept bol vyvinutý podľa hmotnosti; použite váhu. Instantné droždie netreba rozpúšťať. Múku z lepkavej ryže dostanete v supermarketoch, ázijských obchodoch a online, alebo veľmi jemne pomeľte lepkavú ryžu; nepoužívajte bežnú bielu ryžovú múku.

Ak má zápara v kroku 1 menej ako 70 °C, ohrievajte ju zakrytú v mikrovlnke po 30 sekundách a zakaždým premiešajte metličkou, kým nezhustne a nedosiahne 70 °C; alebo ju miešajte na malej nepriľnavej panvici na stredne miernom ohni. Neprevarte ju; preložte do misky a pokračujte krokom 2.
Kysnutie cez noc v chladničke je nepovinné, ale pridá chuť; vychladenie pred tvarovaním je nevyhnutné, inak sa s lepkavým cestom nedá pracovať.

Recept je na rovnú formu 23 × 10 × 10 cm. V menšej rozšírenej forme alebo v zakrytej forme pullman zmenšite každú guľu cesta na 200 g a zvyšok upečte ako žemľu na malom vymastenom plechu vedľa bochníka dozlatista, 17 až 20 minút.

Pri bochníku s vekom nechajte cesto vykysnúť 1 cm nad okraj, pečte 30 minút prikryté a potom bez veka, kým dobre nezhnedne a vnútri nemá aspoň 88 °C, ešte 20 až 30 minút. Rozpusteným maslom sa vrch potiera len pri pečení bez veka (alebo žemľa).

38 g (3 tbsp) granulated sugar
209 g whole milk, brought to a boil
42 g (3 tbsp) cold unsalted butter, cut into 1.5 cm cubes
45 g (3 tbsp) cold whole milk
1 large egg yolk (≈18 g)
280 g bread or high-protein all-purpose flour

3/4 tsp (2 g) instant yeast

sk.t: 70 g sladká (lepkavá) ryžová múka (asi 6 PL (45 g) a 1 ČL (2,5 g))
209 g whole milk, brought to a boil
42 g (3 tbsp) cold unsalted butter, cut into 1.5 cm cubes
280 g chlebová múka alebo hladká múka s vysokým obsahom bielkovín
6 g (2 ČL) hrubozrnná soľ Diamond Crystal (pri jemnej soli dáme objemovo polovicu, hmotnostne rovnako)
14 g (1 tbsp) unsalted butter, melted, for brushing loaf

en.t: 1. For the Scald: In a medium bowl, whisk glutinous rice flour and sugar to combine. Add boiling milk and rapidly whisk until mixture thickens to pudding-like consistency and registers between 68 and 77 °C.
2. Scatter butter over the scalded rice flour mixture, cover bowl with plastic wrap, and let sit until butter has melted and mixture has cooled to at least 27 °C, about 1 hour.
3. For the Dough: Add milk and egg yolk to the scald mixture. Whisk until well-combined and at or below 24 °C; if not at temperature, cover and let sit until it reaches 24 °C.

4. In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the dough hook attachment, combine flour, salt, and yeast, and mix on low speed until well combined, about 15 seconds. Turn off mixer, then add scalded rice flour mixture all at once and mix on low speed until dough is uniform, about 2 minutes, using a flexible spatula to scrape down sides of bowl and dough hook as needed.

5. Increase speed to medium and mix until dough just starts to come away from sides of bowl, about 8 minutes. (The dough will remain sticky and webby. Do not overmix here; the dough should not be bouncy.)

6. Using nonstick baking spray, grease a large bowl; the bowl should be big enough for dough to double in size. Transfer dough to the greased bowl, and cover bowl tightly with plastic wrap. Let sit at warm room temperature (24 to 27 °C) until the dough is puffy and expanded by about 1 1/2 times its original volume, 60 to 90 minutes.
7. Using lightly moistened hands, deflate the dough until it is restored to its original volume. Cover tightly and refrigerate until dough is at least 13 °C, at least 2 hours and up to 24 hours.

8. To Bake a Yama ("Mountain") Style Loaf: Using nonstick baking spray, grease a 23 × 10 × 10 cm loaf pan. Lightly flour top of dough and transfer to a lightly-floured work surface. Using a knife or dough scraper, divide dough into 3 equal pieces, about 225 g each. Gently shape each into a round. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and let sit for 30 minutes.

9. Working with one ball of dough at a time (seam-side up), lightly flour exterior of dough and, using a rolling pin, flatten and roll each ball into a 13 × 20 cm oval. Fold the long ends into the center to form a 10 cm wide strip. Roll strip into 23 × 10 cm rectangle, flouring dough on both sides as needed to prevent sticking. Starting at the short end, roll dough into a 10 cm-wide log, stretching it gently as you go and keeping the spiraled edges even. Pinch the seam closed, set aside. Repeat with remaining dough balls and place each shaped cylinder of dough into greased loaf pan, side-by-side, seam-side down, and evenly spaced apart. (The spiraled ends should be facing the long side of pan.)
10. Loosely cover with plastic wrap and let sit at warm room temperature (24 to 27 °C) until top of loaf is 1.5 cm below lip of pan, 1 to 2 hours.
11. Halfway through proofing time, adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 150 °C (fan 130 °C).
12. When loaf is ready to bake, transfer loaf to oven. Bake until loaf is well-browned and has an internal temperature of at least 88 °C, 50 to 60 minutes.

13. Transfer the pan to a cooling rack and brush the exposed surface of loaf with butter. Let cool for 5 minutes, then remove loaf from pan and cool on wire rack, to room temperature, at least 1 hour.

1. Zápara: v stredne veľkej mise metličkou premiešame lepkavú ryžovú múku a cukor. Pridáme vriace mlieko a rýchlo šľaháme, kým zmes nezhustne na konzistenciu pudingu a nemá teplotu medzi 68 a 77 °C.
2. Na zaparenú zmes ryžovej múky rozložíme maslo, misu prikryjeme potravinovou fóliou a necháme postáť, kým sa maslo nerozpustí a zmes nevychladne aspoň na 27 °C, asi 1 hodinu.
3. Cesto: k zápare pridáme mlieko a žĺtok. Metličkou miešame, kým sa dobre nespoja a teplota nie je 24 °C alebo nižšia; ak teplota nesedí, prikryjeme a necháme postáť, kým nedosiahne 24 °C.

4. V mise stojanového mixéra s hákom na cesto spojíme múku, soľ a droždie a miešame na nízkej rýchlosti, kým sa dobre nespoja, asi 15 sekúnd. Mixér vypneme, pridáme naraz zaparenú zmes ryžovej múky a miešame na nízkej rýchlosti, kým cesto nie je jednotné, asi 2 minúty; podľa potreby pružnou stierkou zoškrabujeme steny misy a hák.

5. Zvýšime rýchlosť na strednú a miešame, kým sa cesto práve nezačne odlepovať od stien misy, asi 8 minút. (Cesto zostane lepkavé a bude ťahať vlákna. Tu ho nepremiešavame; cesto by nemalo byť pružné ako guma.)

6. Veľkú misu vymastíme sprejom na pečenie; misa by mala byť dosť veľká, aby cesto mohlo zdvojnásobiť objem. Cesto preložíme do vymastenej misy a misu tesne prikryjeme potravinovou fóliou. Necháme pri teplej izbovej teplote (24 až 27 °C), kým cesto nie je nadýchané a nezväčší sa asi na 1 1/2-násobok pôvodného objemu, 60 až 90 minút.
7. Mierne navlhčenými rukami cesto prepučíme, kým sa nevráti na pôvodný objem. Tesne prikryjeme a dáme do chladničky, kým cesto nemá najviac 13 °C, aspoň 2 hodiny a najviac 24 hodín.

8. Pečenie bochníka v štýle jama („hora“): formu na chlieb s rozmermi 23 × 10 × 10 cm vymastíme sprejom na pečenie. Vrch cesta zľahka pomúčime a preložíme ho na zľahka pomúčenú pracovnú plochu. Nožom alebo škrabkou rozdelíme cesto na 3 rovnaké kusy, každý asi 225 g. Každý jemne vytvarujeme do guľky. Voľne prikryjeme potravinovou fóliou a necháme 30 minút postáť.

9. S každou guľkou cesta pracujeme zvlášť (spojom nahor): povrch cesta zľahka pomúčime a valčekom sploštíme a vyvaľkáme každú guľku na ovál s rozmermi 13 × 20 cm. Dlhé konce preložíme do stredu, aby vznikol pás široký 10 cm. Pás vyvaľkáme na obdĺžnik s rozmermi 23 × 10 cm a podľa potreby cesto z oboch strán pomúčime, aby sa nelepilo. Od kratšieho konca cesto zvinieme do valca širokého 10 cm, pričom ho jemne naťahujeme a špirálovité okraje udržiavame rovné. Spoj stlačíme, aby sa uzavrel, a odložíme. Opakujeme so zvyšnými guľkami cesta a každý vytvarovaný valček cesta vložíme do vymastenej formy vedľa seba, spojom nadol a v rovnakých rozostupoch. (Špirálovité konce by mali smerovať k dlhej strane formy.)
10. Voľne prikryjeme potravinovou fóliou a necháme pri teplej izbovej teplote (24 až 27 °C), kým vrch bochníka nie je 1,5 cm pod okrajom formy, 1 až 2 hodiny.
11. V polovici kysnutia nastavíme rošt do stredu rúry a rúru rozohrejeme na 150 °C (teplovzdušnú na 130 °C).
12. Keď je bochník pripravený na pečenie, vložíme ho do rúry. Pečieme, kým nie je bochník dobre opečený a vnútri nemá aspoň 88 °C, 50 až 60 minút.

13. Formu preložíme na mriežku a odkrytý povrch bochníka potrieme maslom. Necháme 5 minút chladnúť, potom bochník vyberieme z formy a necháme ho na mriežke vychladnúť na izbovú teplotu, aspoň 1 hodinu.

en.t: 1. In a medium pot, combine corn and water; pick out any stones that may be hiding among the corn kernels. Add pickling lime and set over medium heat. Bring to a simmer, adjusting heat to maintain simmer. Cook until corn is tenderized but not overly soft, about 45 minutes. (You can chew a kernel up to test, or break one open: It's done when the kernel looks mostly hydrated but still has a tiny core of visible starchiness.) The timing can vary based on corn type, so start checking at 30 minutes and continue cooking beyond 45 minutes if it's still too raw. Top up with water as needed to keep corn submerged.

2. Remove from heat, cover pot, and let corn stand at room temperature overnight. The bran on the corn should now rub off easily. Drain corn in a colander, set under running cold water, and rub kernels vigorously between hands to remove most of the bran; corn should turn a brighter shade as bran comes off. Allow to drain well, then transfer corn to a food processor.

3. Process corn at high speed, adding as much water as you need, little by little, to help the blades process the corn, about 10 minutes; scrape down the sides of the bowl at least a few times during processing. The dough is ready when no large corn chunks remain and the purée has the texture of a thick hummus.

4. Scrape corn dough into a mixing bowl and add masa harina, little by little, working it in with your hands, until corn dough has the texture of Play-Doh: soft and supple, but not wet. To test texture, roll a small ball of dough between your hands, then press it between your fingers: If the edges crack, it's too dry, but if it sticks to your skin, it's too wet. Work in more water or masa harina, little by little, until you hit that sweet spot.

5. Cut 2 sides plus the zipper-top off of a zipper-lock bag, leaving it attached on only 1 side; line tortilla press with the plastic and trim to fit. Preheat well-seasoned griddle or cast iron skillet over medium-high heat. Working with one piece at a time, roll a portion of corn dough into a golf ball–sized ball, then flatten slightly. Set portioned corn dough between the sheets of plastic, then press flat using the tortilla press. Try not to press so hard that the tortilla edge becomes too thin; about 1 mm in thickness or slightly less is what you want. Rotate plastic 180° and press again to ensure even thickness.

6. Carefully peel tortilla from plastic and place in preheated skillet. Cook until bottom side is dried, about 30 seconds, then flip using a thin metal spatula and cook other side until dried, about 30 seconds longer; tortilla may puff up and brown lightly in spots, which is fine. Adjust heat as necessary to prevent scorching. (If tortillas start to stick to griddle or skillet, rub cooking surface with a paper towel lightly moistened with vegetable oil, then buff away any excess oiliness.)
7. Stack tortillas as they are done, keeping them wrapped in a clean kitchen towel or tortilla holder to trap heat and steam. Serve immediately.

1. V stredne veľkom hrnci spojíme kukuricu a vodu; vyberieme kamienky, ktoré sa môžu skrývať medzi zrnami. Pridáme hasené vápno (cal) a postavíme na stredný oheň. Privedieme k miernemu varu a oheň upravíme tak, aby sa udržal. Varíme, kým kukurica nezmäkne, ale nie je príliš mäkká, asi 45 minút. (Na skúšku môžeme zrno rozhryznúť alebo rozlomiť: je hotové, keď zrno vyzerá takmer celé nasiaknuté, no stále má drobné jadierko viditeľného škrobu.) Čas sa môže líšiť podľa druhu kukurice, preto ju začneme kontrolovať po 30 minútach, a ak je ešte príliš surová, varíme ju aj dlhšie ako 45 minút. Podľa potreby dolievame vodu, aby kukurica zostala ponorená.

2. Odstavíme z ohňa, hrniec prikryjeme a kukuricu necháme cez noc postáť pri izbovej teplote. Šupka z kukurice by teraz mala ľahko odchádzať. Kukuricu scedíme v cedidle pod tečúcou studenou vodou a zrná energicky šúchame medzi dlaňami, aby sme odstránili väčšinu šupiek; keď šupky odchádzajú, kukurica by mala zosvetlieť. Necháme dobre odkvapkať a kukuricu preložíme do kuchynského robota.

3. Kukuricu mixujeme na vysokej rýchlosti a po troške pridávame toľko vody, koľko treba, aby ju nože dokázali spracovať, asi 10 minút; počas mixovania aspoň niekoľkokrát zoškrabeme steny nádoby. Cesto je hotové, keď v ňom nezostanú väčšie kúsky kukurice a pyré má konzistenciu hustého hummusu.

4. Kukuričné cesto zoškrabeme do misy a po troške pridávame masa harina, ktorú rukami zapracúvame, kým cesto nemá konzistenciu modelovacej hmoty: mäkké a poddajné, ale nie mokré. Konzistenciu vyskúšame tak, že medzi dlaňami vyvaľkáme malú guľku cesta a stlačíme ju medzi prstami: ak okraje praskajú, je príliš suché, ak sa lepí na kožu, je príliš mokré. Po troške zapracúvame ďalšiu vodu alebo masa harina, kým nedosiahneme tú správnu konzistenciu.

5. Z uzatvárateľného vrecka odstrihneme 2 boky a uzáver, takže zostane spojené len na 1 strane; lis na tortilly vystelieme fóliou a orežeme ju na veľkosť. Dobre vypálenú platňu alebo liatinovú panvicu rozohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni. S každým kúskom pracujeme zvlášť: časť kukuričného cesta vyvaľkáme do guľky veľkosti golfovej loptičky a mierne ju sploštíme. Odmeraný kúsok cesta vložíme medzi fólie a lisom na tortilly ho stlačíme naplocho. Snažíme sa netlačiť tak silno, aby bol okraj tortilly príliš tenký; chceme hrúbku asi 1 mm alebo o čosi menej. Fóliu otočíme o 180° a znova stlačíme, aby bola hrúbka rovnomerná.

6. Tortillu opatrne stiahneme z fólie a položíme na rozohriatu panvicu. Pečieme, kým spodná strana nevyschne, asi 30 sekúnd, potom ju tenkou kovovou obracačkou obrátime a pečieme druhú stranu, kým nevyschne, ešte asi 30 sekúnd; tortilla sa môže nafúknuť a miestami zľahka zhnednúť, čo je v poriadku. Oheň podľa potreby upravujeme, aby sa nepripálila. (Ak sa tortilly začnú lepiť na platňu alebo panvicu, potrieme povrch papierovou utierkou zľahka navlhčenou rastlinným olejom a prebytočný olej vyleštíme.)
7. Hotové tortilly ukladáme na seba a necháme ich zabalené v čistej kuchynskej utierke alebo v nádobe na tortilly, aby udržali teplo a paru. Hneď podávame.

en.v: Lavash are best eaten within 6 hours of baking; store in a plastic bag if not using within that time frame. They can be refreshed by overlapping the breads in a single layer on a rack set into a rimmed baking sheet in a 95 °C oven for 3 to 5 minutes. They can also be refreshed by spraying the breads with a water mister bottle or even placing them very briefly under running water; allow to rest for 30 minutes to rehydrate. (Lavash can be dried out completely by placing the breads in a single layer on a rack set into a rimmed baking sheet in a 95 °C oven for 50 to 60 minutes, after which they can be broken into delicate, crisp crackers.)

sk.v: Lavaše sú najlepšie do 6 hodín po upečení; ak ich dovtedy nezjete, uchovávajte ich v plastovom vrecku. Osviežiť ich môžete tak, že ich v jednej vrstve s prekrytím uložíte na mriežku v plechu s okrajom a dáte na 3 až 5 minút do rúry vyhriatej na 95 °C. Osviežiť sa dajú aj porosením vodou z rozprašovača alebo veľmi krátkym podržaním pod tečúcou vodou; potom ich nechajte 30 minút odpočívať, aby nasali vlhkosť. (Lavaše môžete aj úplne vysušiť: v jednej vrstve na mriežke v plechu s okrajom v rúre vyhriatej na 95 °C 50 až 60 minút; potom sa dajú lámať na jemné chrumkavé krekry.)

Guľky cesta uložte do chladničky buď na podnos, aspoň 5 cm od seba a tesne zakryté fóliou tak, aby ste ich nestlačili, alebo každú do samostatnej 475 ml nádobky. Cesto vaľkajte a pečte rovno z chladničky; nenechajte ho zohriať.

en.t: 180 g bread flour, or high-protein all-purpose flour, plus extra for flouring the counter
30 g whole wheat flour
11 g (4 tsp) cornstarch
1 g (1/4 tsp) instant yeast; not RapidRise or active dry
170 g milk, warmed to 24 °C
10 g (2 tsp) vegetable oil, plus extra for coating dough balls
7 g (1 tsp) honey
5 g (1 heaping tsp) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt use half as much by volume

sk.t: 180 g chlebová múka alebo hladká múka s vysokým obsahom bielkovín a trochu navyše na podsypanie pracovnej plochy
1 g (¼ ČL) instantné droždie (nie RapidRise ani aktívne sušené droždie)
10 g (2 ČL) rastlinný olej a trochu navyše na potretie guliek cesta
5 g (1 vrchovatá ČL) hrubozrnná soľ Diamond Crystal (pri jemnej soli objemovo polovica)

en.t: 1. Place flours, cornstarch, and yeast in a medium bowl and whisk to combine. Add milk, oil, and honey and stir with a wooden spoon or dough whisk until combined and no dry flour remains, 15 to 30 seconds. Cover and let sit at room temperature for 20 minutes.

2. Add salt to top of dough and, using lightly moistened hands (or a dough whisk), knead in bowl until salt is fully incorporated and dough is even in texture, about 30 seconds. Cover and let sit at room temperature for 45 minutes.
3. Using lightly moistened hands, knead dough in bowl until uniform in texture, 5 to 10 seconds. Cover and let sit at room temperature until puffy and not quite doubled in volume, 30 to 60 minutes.

4. Transfer dough to lightly floured counter, flour top of dough lightly, and divide into 4 equal pieces (about 100 g each). Form each piece into a smooth, taut round. Coat each dough ball lightly with oil, then transfer to lightly oiled containers or a lightly oiled tray, spaced at least 5 cm apart. Cover and refrigerate for 12 to 24 hours.

5. Adjust oven rack to lower-middle position. Place baking steel or stone on rack, and preheat oven to maximum temperature, 260 or 290 °C, for at least 30 minutes if using baking steel, or 1 hour if using a stone.

6. Once oven and baking steel/stone are preheated, set broiler to high and remove dough balls from refrigerator. Set a wire rack inside a rimmed baking sheet, cover with a clean dish towel, and set aside. Place 45 g flour in a mound on center of countertop and transfer one ball of dough to flour. Flip dough ball over once or twice to coat thoroughly with flour. Using a rolling pin, roll gently into a roughly 36 × 28 cm rounded rectangle, flipping dough as needed to coat with flour and prevent sticking or tearing.

7. Using a fine pastry brush, brush excess flour from top surface of dough. Transfer lavash to a 46 × 33 cm sheet of parchment, and then to a lightly floured wide peel, rimless cookie sheet, or inverted rimmed baking sheet. Using misting bottle, mist top of dough lightly with water. Transfer to baking surface.

8. Bake until dough puffs up into a single balloon, about 30 seconds; the color change will not be substantial. Flip dough, remove the parchment sheet, and bake for an additional 10 seconds. (If dough does not puff completely after 30 seconds, flip anyway.) Transfer to prepared cooling rack and cover loosely with towel. Using bench scraper, gather flour into mound on countertop again. Repeat rolling and baking with remaining dough balls, one at a time, reusing the same parchment and stacking finished lavash on top of previous ones. Allow the stack of lavash to steam for at least 15 minutes. Brush off excess flour from each lavash, and serve.
